title: Digital Marketing Manager (Manufacturing / B2B)
company: Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Manager (Manufacturing / B2 B)

£45,000 - £50,000 + Hybrid Working + Fantastic Holiday Entitlement + Training + Career Progression + Company Benefits

Tamworth

Are you an experienced Marketing Manager with a strong background in B2 B marketing, digital campaigns and CRM?

Do you want to join an innovative clean energy business helping to transform the UK's renewable energy landscape through cutting-edge biomethane solutions?

This company are an innovative clean energy business pioneering the production and supply of on-farm biomethane and CNG solutions. By connecting producers and end users, they enable businesses to decarbonise their operations, reduce emissions and adopt sustainable fuel alternatives. With a strong commercial pipeline and advanced technology, they are driving the transition towards a low-carbon future and reshaping the UK's renewable energy market.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of the UK marketing strategy, developing and delivering campaigns that increase brand awareness, generate high-quality leads and support commercial growth. You will work closely with senior leadership, sales and product teams, while overseeing a small marketing function and helping shape the company's presence across digital channels, events and product launches.

On offer is the opportunity to join a growing and forward-thinking organisation where you will have genuine ownership of the marketing function, alongside hybrid working, training, career progression and the opportunity to make a visible commercial impact.

This role would suit an experienced Marketing Manager with a strong B2 B background who is confident using CRM and marketing automation platforms, particularly HubSpot, and enjoys combining strategic planning with hands-on campaign delivery.

The Role:
- Develop and deliver the UK marketing strategy in line with wider commercial objectives
- Manage and optimise HubSpot CRM, marketing automation, campaigns and customer journeys
- Drive lead generation and improve the quality and conversion of marketing leads
- Develop targeted email campaigns, landing pages, forms, CTAs and lead nurturing journeys
- Manage customer data, segmentation and CRM governance to maximise commercial opportunities
- Create and oversee engaging content across social media, digital channels and marketing collateral
- Support go-to-market strategies for new products, services and commercial initiatives

The Person:
- Proven experience as a Marketing Manager or in a similar senior marketing position
- Strong B2 B marketing experience, ideally within an engineering, energy, technology or industrial environment

Reference: BBBH 27257

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates. The salary advertised is a guideline for this position. The offered remuneration will depend on your experience, qualifications, and skillset.

Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job, you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found on our website.

title: Marketing Events Executive
description:
Marketing & Events Executive

Stafford Permanent Monday-Friday, 7:30am-4:30pm
- £40,000 - £45,000 basic salary
- Car allowance
- Profit Share Bonus Scheme following probation
- Daily lunch provided
- BUPA wellbeing and mental health support
- Ongoing training and professional development

Are you a commercially focused marketing professional with a passion for events, exhibitions and customer engagement?

Do you enjoy taking an idea from the planning stage through to delivery and seeing the direct impact it has on customers and the wider business?

We are looking for a Marketing & Events Executive to join an established and growing organisation based in the Stafford area. This is a hands-on position combining event management, customer engagement, content and wider marketing activity.

You will work closely with the marketing and commercial teams to deliver events and campaigns that strengthen the company's profile, create new opportunities and provide valuable insight into customers and the wider market.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of a varied programme of marketing and event activity, including:
- Researching and selecting relevant exhibitions, conferences and industry events.
- Coordinating events from initial planning through to delivery and post-event follow-up.
- Managing event budgets, suppliers, promotional materials, logistics and deadlines.
- Attending exhibitions and events across the UK, representing the business and engaging with customers and prospects.
- Working alongside the sales team to maximise leads and opportunities generated through events.
- Measuring event performance, analysing leads and reporting on commercial return.
- Organising customer visits and gathering feedback and market intelligence.
- Developing customer stories, testimonials and case studies for use across marketing channels.
- Supporting the creation of presentations, brochures, sales literature and other marketing materials.
- Keeping up to date with competitor activity, industry developments and customer trends.
- Supporting brand awareness campaigns, product launches and other marketing initiatives.
- Maintaining accurate customer and activity information within the company's CRM.
- Providing general marketing support to the wider business and contributing new ideas.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded marketer who is comfortable working with customers, managing projects and representing a business at industry events.

You should have:
- At least 3 years' experience in events, event marketing, B2 B marketing or a similar role.
- Previous experience organising exhibitions, trade shows or customer-facing events.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- The confidence to build relationships with customers, prospects, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage several projects at the same time.
- A commercial mindset and an understanding of how marketing activity can contribute to business growth.
- A full UK driving licence and flexibility to travel nationally.
- Previous experience within engineering, manufacturing, industrial, construction, environmental or another technical B2 B environment would be advantageous.
- Experience using HubSpot or another CRM/marketing automation system would be beneficial.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager B2 B HubSpot
- £45,000 - £50,000 per annum
- Tamworth , Staffordshire - Hybrid working
- Training and development
- Career progression
- The opportunity to shape and develop the marketing function
- A commercially focused and growing environment

Are you an experienced Marketing Manager with a strong B2 B background and hands-on experience using HubSpot?

Are you looking for an opportunity where you can take ownership of the marketing function and play a key role in the growth of an innovative business?

As Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of the UK marketing strategy, developing and delivering campaigns that build brand awareness, generate high-quality leads and directly support commercial growth. Working closely with senior leadership, sales and product teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the company's marketing approach across digital channels, CRM, content, events and product launches.

The Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic marketing planning with campaign execution, while having the freedom to develop processes, improve lead generation and make a measurable commercial difference.
- Develop and execute the UK marketing strategy in line with wider commercial objectives.
- Own and optimise HubSpot CRM, including marketing automation, workflows, customer journeys and lead management.
- Develop and deliver targeted B2 B campaigns to generate high-quality sales leads.
- Create and manage email campaigns, landing pages, forms, CTAs and lead nurturing journeys through HubSpot.
- Manage customer data, segmentation and CRM processes to improve engagement and conversion.
- Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, nurture prospects and support pipeline development.
- Create and oversee engaging content across social media, websites, email and wider digital channels.
- Support the marketing strategy for new products, services and commercial initiatives.
- Plan and coordinate industry events, exhibitions and other lead-generation activity.
- Monitor campaign performance and use data and reporting to continually improve marketing activity.
- Work closely with senior stakeholders to strengthen the company's brand and market presence.

About You
- Proven experience as a Marketing Manager or in a similar senior marketing position.
- Strong B2 B marketing experience, ideally within engineering, energy, technology, industrial or another technical environment.
- Hands-on HubSpot experience is essential, with confidence managing CRM, automation, workflows, campaigns and reporting.
- Strong understanding of B2 B lead generation, nurturing and marketing-to-sales processes.
- Experience creating and managing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to connect marketing activity to measurable business results.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging B2 B content.
- Organised, proactive and comfortable working in a growing business where you can take ownership and make decisions.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing business at an exciting stage of its development, where marketing has a direct role to play in commercial growth.

You'll have genuine ownership of the marketing function, the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and the freedom to develop and improve the company's marketing strategy.

If you're an experienced B2 B Marketing Manager with strong HubSpot expertise and are looking for a role where you can make a visible commercial impact, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager (B2B)
description:
Elevate your career in B2 B marketing with the Customer Relationship Manager role, where strategy, partnership building, and co-marketing opportunities come together. This is a senior, externally focused position designed for a confident relationship builder who enjoys turning customer goals into measurable commercial results. If you thrive on building long-term ties, shaping co-branding programmes, and delivering standout campaigns, the Customer Relationship Manager role could be your next great move.

What You Will Do:
- Build and manage long-term marketing relationships with key customers, becoming the primary marketing contact for assigned accounts.
- Own and evolve co-branding strategy, delivering initiatives such as case studies, product launches, joint PR/editorial opportunities, and digital campaigns.
- Embed the company's technologies into customer marketing strategies, supporting messaging, assets, and technical positioning while staying aligned with brand and regulatory requirements.
- Lead the exhibition and events programme, including planning, logistics, materials, on-site execution, and performance tracking (leads, engagement, and ROI).
- Collaborate closely with sales and the Global Marketing Director to align customer engagement activity with commercial priorities and revenue growth.
- Gather and share market and customer intelligence to identify new sectors, applications, and partnership opportunities.

What You Will Bring:
- Strong experience in customer-facing marketing, account management, or partnership roles, with the ability to build trust and drive outcomes.
- Proven ability to plan and deliver co-marketing or partnership initiatives, from opportunity identification through to execution.
- Clear commercial awareness, linking marketing activity to business results and customer value.
- Confidence communicating and presenting to a range of stakeholders, with excellent organisational skills.
- Experience coordinating events or exhibitions, with a structured approach to project management and delivery.

The Customer Relationship Manager role sits within the B2 B marketing industry and plays a key part in strengthening long-term customer growth by creating structured co-marketing plans, supporting high-quality customer stories, and ensuring consistent brand visibility across customer-facing activity. Your work directly supports the company's commercial growth by turning customer relationships into practical, revenue-aligned marketing opportunities and measurable impact.

Interested?:

If the Customer Relationship Manager role sounds like the kind of challenge where strategic partnerships and creative co-marketing can make a real difference, apply now and take the next step in your B2 B marketing journey.

Your CV will be forwarded to Jonathan Lee Recruitment, a leading engineering and manufacturing recruitment consultancy established in 1978. The services advertised by Jonathan Lee Recruitment are those of an Employment Agency.
In order for your CV to be processed effectively, please ensure your name, email address, phone number and location (post code OR town OR county, as a minimum) are included.

title: Senior Media Relations Exec
description:
SF Partners are recruiting for a Senior Media Relations Manager for a business based in Tamworth
Office based
up to £37,000

About the role: This exciting role reports directly to the Marketing Manager and sits within a dynamic in-house team responsible for delivering Marketing, Communications, and Design services across the group of companies. As a Senior Media Relations Executive, you will play a key role in supporting the group's communications strategy, working closely with the Media Relations Consultant and Marketing Manager. You'll have the opportunity to shape how the company is represented across industry media platforms, identifying and leveraging opportunities to enhance the group's reputation and build its brand identity.

Main duties
- Strategy and Planning
- Lead the development and implementation of proactive and reactive media relations plans aligning with the group-wide strategic marketing objectives.
- Oversee reputation management activities, including reputational risk monitoring and crisis-response planning.
- Provide guidance on media positioning, messaging, and emerging issues when needed.
- Content and Editorial Oversight
- Produce and oversee high-quality content for trade media in the industry, including thought-leadership articles, technical features, product releases, business updates, case studies, web stories, and award submissions.
- Act as editorial lead, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with brand tone of voice.
- Identify compelling stories from across the business and shape them into publishable media assets.
- Support media copywriting, submissions and pitches for multiple companies, covering a range of industry sectors including but not limited to the Group community support initiatives
- Media Relationship Management
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key journalists, editors, and industry publications.
- Lead the pitching process to secure impactful high-value coverage across trade and digital media.
- Maintain and develop media lists, ensuring targeted outreach and effective segmentation.
- Press Office Leadership
- Manage the press office function, ensuring timely, accurate responses to media inquiries. Escalate sensitive issues appropriately and coordinate cross-departmental responses.
- Monitor media coverage and competitor activity, providing regular insights and recommendations.
- Cross Functional Collaboration
- Lead monthly planning meetings to align PR activity with business priorities.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all channels.
- Support with proofreading and supplying copy for company literature, website content, and other collateral when necessary.
- Brand and Reputation Development
- Identify opportunities to publish positive, brand-enhancing content across industry platforms.
- Ensure all external communications adhere to brand, campaign, and tone-of-voice guidelines.
- Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory changes, and media developments to inform PR strategy.

Skills and Experience
The successful candidate will have significant experience of working in a media relations role.
Demonstrate a proficiency in copywriting with proven ability to produce quality content with a focus on products and feature material within trade media.
Well organised, reliable and hardworking individual, able to work independently and as part of a team.
Confident and able to form relationships with stakeholders both internally and externally and able to demonstrate strong verbal communications skills.
Experience developing and maintaining relationships with Trade Media/Magazine Editors.
Confidently demonstrates a strategic input, not just execution.
Able to lead and take ownership of projects or campaigns from a media relations perspective.
Proven experience to confidently develop, coordinate and execute a cross-channel communications plan.
Self-motivated and enthusiastic to continuously improve knowledge and skills.
